exposure: Dietary patterns ('fruit and vegetables', 'healthy', 'traditional', 'fat and sugar')
cohort: The study included 249 healthy Jordanian pregnant women in their third trimester of pregnancy who attended antenatal clinics.
finding: No significant association was found between the identified dietary patterns and the occurrence of Caesarean section across all tertiles.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between the identified dietary patterns and the occurrence of Caesarean section across all tertiles.
